body:
## What
JEV v2 per docs/FRUITFLY-JEV-MOTH.md §4.3: split monolithic Abstain into HOLD vs CAST, mirroring the fly's bimodal evidence-absence response (darkness straight-flight vs odor-OFF casting).

**Stacked on #2** (needs js/jev_gate.js + edge/nl_route.js from edge-nl-graph).

## Changes
- js/jev_gate.js: belief register (EMA |evidence|, decay 0.9), abstainMode(ci) — CAST iff last nonzero ψ was −1 or belief < 0.10 floor, capped 1/cell/16-frame window, counters receipted; markRejected() host hook
- edge/nl_route.js: editDistanceN (true bounded Levenshtein, fuzzy-1 parity preserved); CAST widening fires when best === null (evidence absence); synonym neighbors at edit distance ≤2 enter scoring at weight ×0.5; single pass
- tools/holdcast_ab.js: seeded (20261001) degraded suite (2 degradations × 50 clean prompts), same-process v1/v2 A/B, wall-clock guard, 6 gate pins
- docs/HOLDCAST-pre-registration.md: sealed BEFORE first run; Revision 1 sealed after first FAIL (12/13 residual failures had zero hits — CAST couldn't fire) and BEFORE re-run; first FAIL receipt preserved in history

## Results (tools/holdcast_ab_receipt.json, verdict INTEGRATE)
- H1: degraded top-1 0.870 → 0.970, **+10 pts**, 11 casts — MET
- H2: clean pinned suite 50/50 both routers, clock ratio 0.48 ≤ 1.05 — MET
- H3: gate register pins 6/6 (cast eligibility, cooldown, counter, rejection register) — MET

## Notes
- CAST never fires on clean well-matched prompts (fires only at best === null) → TS mirror parity (#3) unaffected; nl_parity runner lives on that branch
- Pre-registered consequence confirmed: only strong-band neighbors (2 × 0.5 = 1.0) can reach route_threshold — medium/weak neighbors widen scoring but cannot alone flip a route
title: JEV v2 HOLD/CAST abstention split (stacked on #2)
